arguments: the text after the skill name, or the request in the conversation
parallel_reads: make one `read` call for each file, all in the same message
start_search_agent: search with the `grep` and `find` tools yourself, because pi has no subagents
start_subagents: do them one at a time yourself, because pi has no subagents
delegate: Do this job yourself, because pi has no subagents.
web_search: a web search tool, if an extension gives one
ask_user: a question in your reply, and then stop
load_skill: read the `SKILL.md` of the `{0}` skill from the skill list
skill_dir_note: `<skill-dir>` is the base directory of this skill. The skill block gives it when the skill loads.
